title: Translucent Explorer settings
description: Stored at %LOCALAPPDATA%\TranslucentExplorer\settings.json (UTF-8, no BOM). Written atomically: temp file + MoveFileExW(MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH). Readers validate per field; an invalid field falls back to its default without discarding valid fields.

backdropMode.description: Requested mode. Effective mode may differ (high contrast, transparency effects off, unsupported build) and is never persisted.

tintColor.description: 'accent' follows the Windows accent color; otherwise sRGB hex. In Solid mode this is the opaque background color.

tintOpacity.description: Strength of the app-drawn tint overlay in Acrylic/Mica. Ignored (but retained) in Solid. Not a DWM material opacity.

surfaceOpacity.description: Opacity of the app-drawn surface layer (theme base color) over the system backdrop, independent of tint. Ignored (but retained) in Solid. Not a DWM material opacity.

customColors.description: ChooseColorW custom color slots; not affected by Reset.
